info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Payments Payments Authorize-v1-spec
info.description: The Payment Authorization API enables businesses to efficiently authorize multiple payments within a single batch operation. This API is instrumental for financial institutions and payment processors looking to streamline their payment workflows. Users can initiate payment authorization requests for a set of transactions, enhancing operational efficiency and reducing processing times. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and accounting software that require robust payment processing capabilities.

post.description: This endpoint processes the authorization of a payment transaction, ensuring that the payment method has sufficient funds and is valid. Upon successful authorization, the payment can proceed to the capture stage.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to authorize a payment transaction. It requires the necessary payment details and user authentication information to process the authorization effectively.

201.description: Payment authorization was successful. A new resource has been created.
